say:1:1230210001:0.text: Not only do the fish have a nice name, but they look beautiful too.
say:1:1230210001:0.source_cn: 不止好听，那种鱼也很好看。
say:1:1230210001:0.male: Not only do the fish have a nice name, but they look beautiful too.
say:1:1230210001:0.female: Not only do the fish have a nice name, but they look beautiful too.

say:2:1230210002:0.text: They resemble raindrops when they leap out of the water.
say:2:1230210002:0.source_cn: 它们从水底跃出的时候，看起来就像雨滴。
say:2:1230210002:0.male: They resemble raindrops when they leap out of the water.
say:2:1230210002:0.female: They resemble raindrops when they leap out of the water.

say:3:1230210003:0.text: They aren't worth much since they're quite common, but I'm happy as long as I catch a fish!
say:3:1230210003:0.source_cn: 虽然因为太常见而不值钱，不过能上钩就行，我不挑！
say:3:1230210003:0.male: They aren't worth much since they're quite common, but I'm happy as long as I catch a fish!
say:3:1230210003:0.female: They aren't worth much since they're quite common, but I'm happy as long as I catch a fish!
